name: MERUNA / Inbox / Outbound Reply Dispatcher • Four Channels

parameters.query:
SELECT m.id AS message_id, m.conversation_id, m.content,
       c.clinic_id, c.channel_id, c.patient_id,
       c.channel_conversation_id,
       ch.provider, ch.type, ch.config AS channel_config,
       ch.phone_number_id, ch.business_account_id,
       ch.provider AS eff_provider,
       COALESCE(cs.api_token, NULL) AS api_token,
       ch.phone_number_id AS gupshup_source,
       COALESCE(cs.tenant_identifier, NULL) AS tenant_identifier,
       COALESCE(p.phone_normalized, p.phone) AS recipient
FROM messages m
JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = c.channel_id
LEFT JOIN get_channel_secret_db(ch.id) cs ON true
LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id
WHERE m.id = COALESCE(NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid, (
  SELECT id FROM messages
  WHERE conversation_id = $2::uuid
    AND direction = 'outgoing'
    AND sender_type IN ('ai', 'clinic')
    AND message_status = 'sent'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
))
  AND m.conversation_id = $2::uuid
  AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
  AND m.message_status IN ('sent','delivered')
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE messages
SET message_status = CASE WHEN $1::boolean THEN 'delivered' ELSE 'failed' END
WHERE id = $2::uuid
RETURNING id AS message_id, message_status;
